SCSensitivityAnalysis.doc: An object that indicates whether sensitive content is present and includes intervention guidance.

SCSensitivityAnalyzer.doc: An object that analyzes media for sensitive content.

SCVideoStreamAnalyzer.doc: An object that monitors a stream of video by analyzing frames for sensitive content.

SCSensitivityAnalysisPolicy.doc: Configurations that represent the way the framework checks for sensitive content and how the app responds.

SCSensitivityAnalysisPolicyDescriptiveIn.doc: An indicator that the person requests overt detection of sensitive content.

SCSensitivityAnalysisPolicyDisabled.doc: An indicator that the app lacks access to use the framework.

SCSensitivityAnalysisPolicySimpleInterve.doc: An indicator that user preference requests discrete detection of sensitive content.

init(rawValue:).doc: Creates an analysis policy value from the enumeration’s underlying type.

-analyzeCGImage:completionHandler:.doc: Analyzes an image for sensitive content and runs code on completion.

-analyzeImageFile:completionHandler:.doc: Analyzes an image file on disk at a URL and runs code on completion.

-analyzeVideoFile:completionHandler:.doc: Analyzes a video file on disk at the given URL and runs the given code on completion.

-analyzePixelBuffer:.doc: Analyzes individual video-stream frames for sensitive content.

-beginAnalysisOfCaptureDeviceInput:error.doc: Analyzes video frames for the given capture device input.

-beginAnalysisOfDecompressionSession:err.doc: Analyzes video frames for the given decompression session.

-continueStream.doc: Indicates that your app is ready to resume video stream analysis.

-initWithParticipantUUID:streamDirection.doc: Creates a video stream analyzer for the given call participant and stream option.

SCSensitiveContentType.doc: A type that identifies a category of sensitive content.

detectedTypes.doc: A property that contains the categories of sensitive content that analysis detects.

sensitive.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the checked content contains sensitive material.

shouldIndicateSensitivity.doc: Intervention guidance that suggests the app indicate the presence of sensitive content.

shouldInterruptVideo.doc: Intervention guidance that suggests the app interrupt the video stream.

shouldMuteAudio.doc: Intervention guidance that suggests the app mute the audio of the current video stream.

SCSensitivityAnalyzer.VideoAnalysisHandl.doc: An object that checks if a video contains sensitive content and provides status updates.

analysisPolicy.doc: A property that determines if the app detects nudity and how the app responds.

videoAnalysis(forFileAt:).doc: Analyzes a video file on disk at a URL for sensitive content.

SCVideoStreamAnalyzerStreamDirection.doc: Options for the different types of analyzed video streams.

analysis.doc: The results of the first detected sensitive video frame.

analysisChangedHandler.doc: A handler that your app provides to react to sensitive content detection.

analysisChanges.doc: A stream your app uses to receive video-stream analysis results.
